scope: Reviewed B5 geography integrated into production JSON with the Hokuriku roster and Kinki Honganji patch; remaining four regions and national acceptance are incomplete.
coordinateMethod: Castle coordinates are approximate named-site longitude/latitude rounded to two decimals. Sources verify site identity/location, not exact surveyed coordinates. District coordinates are authored gameplay markers fitted to the existing outline and 40–180 world-unit parent radius; they are not historical boundary centroids.
districtMethod: County names and named local subdivisions denote gameplay allocations. Combined Wakasa is represented inside prov.echizen per plan14. Koku, population, commerce, garrison and road travel fields are authored canonical game abstractions, not historical measurements.
ownershipMethod: Owners follow the explicit plan14 B5 castle allocation. Nochiseyama belonged to Wakasa Takeda in the historical period, so its Asakura allocation is a scenario abstraction. Ono uses the later Echizen-Ono/Kameyama site geographically; it does not assert that this castle existed in1560. It is not a relabelled Iyama or Inuyama castle.
